source.description:
## PROBLEM
The service-skills v2 epic (xtrm-b86y5) consolidated the 5 separate skills (creating-/scoping-/updating-/using-service-skills + the service-skills-set bundle) into ONE 'service-skills' skill. But consumers that installed pre-v2 still carry the old trinity dirs under .xtrm/skills/default/ (and thus symlinked into .xtrm/skills/active/). Verified fleet-wide after the 0.8.5 propagation: every mercury repo's active view lists creating-service-skills, scoping-service-skills, updating-service-skills, using-service-skills alongside the new 'service-skills'. They are vestigial (no collision — distinct names) but dead weight + confusing, and drift from the v2 single-skill model.

## OPEN QUESTIONS
- Are these still shipped in the xtrm-tools package registry (i.e. re-installed on every xt update), or orphaned in consumer default/ from an old install? Check .xtrm/registry.json + docs/skills-ownership.json.
- If orphaned: xt update/install copies new files but does not REMOVE files no longer in the registry → need an explicit prune step (registry-driven) or a one-time cleanup.

## SCOPE
xtrm-tools registry/install prune logic (cli/src/core/registry-scaffold.ts or skills-materializer); possibly a one-time cleanup in ensureServiceSkills. Consumer .xtrm/skills/default + active views.

## SUCCESS
Consumers' default/active views contain only the consolidated 'service-skills' (+ the per-repo umbrella), with the 4 stale trinity skills removed; idempotent; registry-gated.

## NON_GOALS
- No change to the consolidated service-skills content model.

## VALIDATION
- [ ] root-cause: registry-shipped vs orphaned
- [ ] prune/cleanup removes the 4 stale skills from a consumer; re-running is a no-op
- [ ] fleet re-propagation shows clean active views
source.title: Remove stale pre-v2 service-skills trinity (creating/scoping/updating/using-service-skills) lingering in consumers
